title: Run Decision Payload Success Response
description: Platform success envelope for GET /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/experiment-runs/{experiment_run_ref}/decision-payload. The decision_payload DTO (analytics/decision_payload_schema.json, unchanged field set) is nested under data. Every string and array is bounded so the encoded response stays within 1 MiB (x-max-response-bytes); meta and metadata are bounded scalar maps. The historical envelope decision_payload_response_schema.json is unchanged and still serves the deprecated analytics path. In this canonical response data.run_id carries the experiment_run_ref (^experiment_run_[0-9a-f]{32}$), never the historical run id; the legacy envelope is unchanged. meta and metadata allow only strings (128 characters), booleans, null and integers within the JavaScript safe-integer range; the decision-payload route does not emit non-integer numbers there.

run_id.description: The experiment_run_ref of the run this decision summarizes (canonical response only).
